before.problem: Detail pages no longer matched the parser, so most rows saved the whole page: site menu plus truncated JSON.

sber.plain_http: 403. Respected: requests go through a normal browser page.

transient_failure_found: One Sber API request hung for 30 s during a 14-query probe, which switched that query to the old slow parser. A similar failure is the likely cause of one error in an earlier run, though that was not confirmed. A hung request now retries once after 2 s, a refusal is not retried, and the old page parser is removed.
limits: A repeat Sber run still takes about a minute, because each of the 14 queries opens its own browser. Sharing one would speed it up.
Known vacancies are skipped without updating last_seen. That belongs to stage 5.
The 144 Yandex snippet rows in the archive were not in the current listing, so these runs did not improve them.
A CI run from GitHub's network may behave differently for Sber. Sber is not on the schedule and this was not tested.
The timings above come from temporary archive copies.

github_actions.blocker: public/online_scraped.json is 19.2 MiB, and the new boards add about 17 MiB of description text alone. MAX_BYTES is 32 MiB in src/github_collection_export.py and src/github_collection_api.py, so adding them to the schedule without moving data out of git would break the export.
